parameters.radii: equal in source construction; variable in task

best_human.provenance: The 26-circle source file supplies equal-radius coordinates with r=0.096362339010, attributed in the selected research summary to Nurmela–Östergård (1999). The 32-circle source file supplies r=0.087858157088; the selected research summary attributes that construction to D. W. Boll, J. Donovan, R. L. Graham, and B. D. Lubachevsky (2000). Each coordinate set is translated from a square centered at the origin. Every radius is reduced by 1/10^9 for exact feasibility after decimal rounding. These feasible equal-circle constructions are transferred to the variable-radius class; they do not establish variable-radius optimality.
best_human.evidence_state: source coordinate files saved; conservative witnesses independently pass exact Fraction wall and pair-distance checks

best_public.provenance: Packomania variable-radius table, lastupdate2026-10-31, rows26 and32 report sums2.635983084919 and2.939572771205. Exact record witnesses were not replayed; frozen human baselines use equal-radius constructions.
best_public.evidence_state: same-parameter primary table checked; best-public witness not reproduced
best_public.origin_type: unknown unless attribution is stated in source/provenance

best_reproduced.provenance: Recomputed from the saved Packomania equal-circle ASCII coordinates after translating centers by (1/2,1/2) and reducing each source radius by 1/10^9.
best_reproduced.ai_provenance: No AI-generated coordinates. The radius safety reduction and exact rational verification were performed for this benchmark.
best_reproduced.evidence_state: saved witnesses pass exact rational wall, pairwise non-overlap, and objective checks

survey_scope_note: Best public means the strongest same-parameter result in the cited checked sources. This is not a claim that every public source has been surveyed. Unmatched parameters are listed separately.
frozen_human_baseline_type: published human construction transferred to a broader feasible class
